review: I've been using this app for over two years and loved it, but the latest update completely broke the dark mode. My eyes are really struggling now. It's such a shame because everything else about this app was perfect.
sentence: It's such a shame because everything else about this app was perfect.

review: The app was great until last week's update. Now my saved playlists keep disappearing every time I restart the app. I've lost months of curated music and I'm really heartbroken about it.
sentence: I've lost months of curated music and I'm really heartbroken about it.

review: Decent productivity app overall, but sadly the offline mode no longer works after the latest patch. I rely on this during my commute and it has completely disrupted my daily routine.
sentence: Sadly the offline mode no longer works after the latest patch.

review: I was so excited to try this app after all the great reviews, but I'm deeply disappointed. The export to PDF feature is completely broken and none of my formatting is preserved. Back to searching for alternatives.
sentence: I was so excited to try this app after all the great reviews, but I'm deeply disappointed.

review: The app used to sync seamlessly between my phone and tablet. Ever since version 3.2, syncing fails almost every single time. It makes my workflow almost unusable and I dread opening it now.
sentence: It makes my workflow almost unusable and I dread opening it now.

review: I loved this budgeting app and recommended it to all my friends. The new update removed the custom category feature which was the whole reason I used it. It's disheartening to see a great app go downhill.
sentence: It's disheartening to see a great app go downhill.

review: Notifications keep failing to arrive on time. I've missed three important reminders this week alone because of this bug. For a reminder app, this is a fundamental failure that makes it completely unreliable.
sentence: Notifications keep failing to arrive on time.

review: I was really looking forward to using this for my college classes, but I was let down pretty quickly. The handwriting recognition is terrible and my notes come out unreadable. Not what I expected at all.
sentence: I was let down pretty quickly.

review: The recent update took away the ability to manually sort tasks in the order I want. Now everything is auto-sorted by date, which completely breaks how I organize my day. I'm not satisfied with this change at all.
sentence: I'm not satisfied with this change at all.

review: Great concept and beautiful design, but sadly you can't back up your data locally without a premium subscription. Losing all my progress when I switched phones was devastating and completely avoidable.
sentence: Sadly you can't back up your data locally without a premium subscription.

review: The map feature has been crashing repeatedly for the past two weeks. I reported the bug but haven't heard back from support. It's really disappointing because I depended on this app every single day.
sentence: It's really disappointing because I depended on this app every single day.

review: This app had so much potential. I purchased the yearly premium plan expecting a full-featured experience, but cross-device sync is still broken. I am deeply let down given how much I paid.
sentence: I am deeply let down given how much I paid.

review: Stories are replaying and starting over again and again without any reason. It ruins the whole experience and I find myself avoiding the app altogether now, which makes me sad because I used to love it.
sentence: Stories are replaying and starting over again and again without any reason.

review: I used to enjoy tracking my workouts here but the heart rate monitor integration stopped working after the update. It just doesn't give me the satisfaction of a complete fitness tracker anymore.
sentence: It just doesn't give me the satisfaction of a complete fitness tracker anymore.

review: The latest update blocks the ability to create unlimited notes without upgrading to the pro version. I've been a free user for years and this sudden paywall is a real blow. Very disappointed in this direction.
sentence: I've been a free user for years and this sudden paywall is a real blow.

review: The customer support chat feature has regular failures, unfortunately. Half the time messages don't send and the other half they arrive hours late. It has made resolving my issues nearly impossible.
sentence: The customer support chat feature has regular failures, unfortunately.

review: I switched from my old app to this one hoping for something better. After two months I still can't figure out how to import my old files properly. I watched multiple tutorials and I'm still stuck. Very dissatisfied with the experience.
sentence: I'm still stuck. Very dissatisfied with the experience.

review: The voice recording feature was the main reason I downloaded this app. After the last update, recordings are cut short at exactly 30 seconds. It has broken my entire note-taking process and I feel let down by the developers.
sentence: I feel let down by the developers.

review: Good app overall but I find a serious problem with the login session expiring every few hours. I need to disconnect and reconnect constantly, which is exhausting. It sadly ruins what is otherwise a solid experience.
sentence: It sadly ruins what is otherwise a solid experience.
